card.name: Linking words before opioid or P-drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, in, on, using or oral that sit right before a drug name, mostly an opioid (hydrocodone, codeine, oxycodone) or a drug name starting with Pe or Py.

modes.label: Link word before opioid name
modes.description: A preposition or verb comes just before an opioid product name in warning text.

modes.label: Route or verb before drug
modes.description: A word like oral or using sits before the next drug name.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward names starting with Pe, Ty or Un.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug name is about to be written, mainly opioid names.
